title: A part-time job
topic: They are talking about work at a bookshop. Why does the man work only on Sundays?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 本屋の仕事について話しています。男の人が日曜日だけ働くのは、どうしてですか。
turns.translation: They are talking about work at a bookshop. Why does the man work only on Sundays?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 新しいアルバイトはどうですか。本屋で働いていると聞きました。毎日行きますか。
turns.translation: How is your new part-time job? I heard you work at a bookshop. Do you go every day?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: いいえ、平日は学校があるので、日曜日だけです。店は駅から近くて便利ですよ。
turns.translation: No, I have school on weekdays, so only on Sundays. The shop is conveniently close to the station.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 平日は学校が忙しいんですね。土曜日も授業があるんですか。
turns.translation: You're busy with school on weekdays, then. Do you also have classes on Saturdays?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 土曜日に授業はありません。でも、一日中、家の店を手伝っています。父と母だけでは大変なので。
turns.translation: I don't have Saturday classes. But I help at my family's shop all day. It's too much for just my father and mother.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: そうなんですか。本屋は土曜日、休みだと思っていました。
turns.translation: I see. I thought the bookshop was closed on Saturdays.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: いいえ、毎日開いています。土曜日も来てほしいと言われましたが、家の手伝いがありますから。
turns.translation: No, it's open every day. They asked me to come on Saturdays too, but I have to help at home.

options.label: 本屋が日曜日だけ開いているからです。
options.translation: Because the bookshop is only open on Sundays.
options.rationale: He says it opens every day.

options.label: 家から本屋まで遠いからです。
options.translation: Because the bookshop is far from his home.
options.rationale: He gives school and family-shop commitments, not distance from home, as his reasons. The shop's proximity to the station does not establish his home commute.

options.label: 朝早く働きたいからです。
options.translation: Because he wants to work early in the morning.
options.rationale: He gives school and family-shop commitments as his reasons, not a wish for an early shift.

options.label: ほかの日は学校や家の手伝いがあるからです。
options.translation: Because other days are taken up by school or helping his family.
options.rationale: Weekday school and Saturday help at the family shop prevent work on the other days.

explanation: His own availability, not the bookshop's opening days, controls the schedule. Combine weekday school with Saturday help at his family's shop.
